description: This file implements the 'git grep' command, providing the functionality for pattern searching within repository files, supporting various options like context lines, threading, pattern types, and submodule recursion.

classes.name: work_item
classes.description: Structure representing a unit of work for grep threads, containing source info, completion status, and output buffer.

methods.name: void add_work(struct grep_opt * opt,struct grep_source * gs)
methods.description: Adds a new work item to the queue for worker threads.

methods.name: struct:work_item * get_work(void)
methods.description: Retrieves the next work item for processing, blocks if none available.

methods.name: void work_done(struct work_item * w)
methods.description: Marks a work item as completed and outputs its result if applicable.

methods.name: void free_repos(void)
methods.description: Frees all repository structures used for submodules.

methods.name: void * run(void * arg)
methods.description: Thread routine executing grep source processing for assigned work items.

methods.name: void strbuf_out(struct grep_opt * opt,const void * buf,size_t size)
methods.description: Callback to append output data to a work item's buffer.

methods.name: void start_threads(struct grep_opt * opt)
methods.description: Initializes threading environment and spawns worker threads.

methods.name: int wait_all(void)
methods.description: Waits for all worker threads to complete processing.

methods.name: int grep_cmd_config(const char * var,const char * value,const struct config_context * ctx,void * cb)
methods.description: Configures grep options based on user settings.

methods.name: void grep_source_name(struct grep_opt * opt,const char * filename,int tree_name_len,struct strbuf * out)
methods.description: Generates filename source strings for output.

methods.name: int grep_oid(struct grep_opt * opt,const struct object_id * oid,const char * filename,int tree_name_len,const char * path)
methods.description: Processes a given object ID through grep sources.

methods.name: int grep_file(struct grep_opt * opt,const char * filename)
methods.description: Processes a file through grep.

methods.name: void append_path(struct grep_opt * opt,const void * data,size_t len)
methods.description: Appends a filename path to the output list.

methods.name: void run_pager(struct grep_opt * opt,const char * prefix)
methods.description: Runs the pager program with the list of matched file paths.

methods.name: int grep_cache(struct grep_opt * opt,const struct pathspec * pathspec,int cached)
methods.description: Grep over cached index entries.

methods.name: int grep_tree(struct grep_opt * opt,const struct pathspec * pathspec,struct tree_desc * tree,struct strbuf * base,int tn_len,int check_attr)
methods.description: Recursive grepping through a Git tree object.

methods.name: int grep_object(struct grep_opt * opt,const struct pathspec * pathspec,struct object * obj,const char * name,const char * path)
methods.description: Greps over a Git object, handling different object types.

methods.name: int grep_objects(struct grep_opt * opt,const struct pathspec * pathspec,const struct object_array * list)
methods.description: Greps over an array of objects.

methods.name: int grep_directory(struct grep_opt * opt,const struct pathspec * pathspec,int exc_std,int use_index)
methods.description: Greps files in a directory structure.

methods.name: int context_callback(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Handles setting context lines for pattern match display.

methods.name: int file_callback(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Handles patterns provided via pattern files.

methods.name: int not_callback(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Processes --not option for pattern matching.

methods.name: int and_callback(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Handles combining multiple pattern options.

methods.name: int open_callback(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Handles the '(' pattern delimiter.

methods.name: int close_callback(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Handles the ')' pattern delimiter.

methods.name: int pattern_callback(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Handles the -e command line pattern specification.

methods.description: unavailable

methods.description: unavailable
